kebab_example: aliyun winnexo replace-manual-memory --content '喜欢简洁的回答。' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceManualMemory

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The owner type. A value of user indicates the personal memory of the authenticated user. A value of group indicates the memory of a specified workspace
parameters.help_zh: user 为鉴权用户的个人记忆；group 为指定协作空间记忆
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to group
parameters.help_zh: 协作空间 ID；ownerType 为 group 时必填
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The complete content of profile.md. An empty string indicates that the memory is cleared. This field is required, but an empty value is allowed
parameters.help_zh: profile.md 完整内容；空字符串表示清空。字段必须传入，空内容允许
parameters.name: content

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

content.description_en: The complete content of the manual memory after it is saved. If the memory is successfully cleared, an empty string is returned
content.description_zh: 保存后的手动记忆完整内容；清空成功时为空字符串

message.example: 当前用户不是群组 cg_12345 的活跃成员
